name: In My Own Words
version: v1.2 · 2026-11-11 · steps 2 and 3 match the app: no menu after Start fresh
intro:
⚠️ BEFORE STEP 1 — check you are in a test copy. Look for the small “🧪 Test copy” mark on the screen. It means this app has never seen you, which is what the steps below expect. If it is missing and the app already shows your own information, you have opened your real app: go back to your list and tap this app's name again, rather than using a bookmark, your history, or an icon on your home screen. Starting in the wrong copy makes the early steps look broken when nothing is wrong.

You will start a life-story book for an example person, add a family member, type one story and one diary page (no talking needed), then look at the finished book and its print preview. You never press the red microphone button in this test.

steps.do: When the app opens, a “Welcome to In My Own Words” card is at the bottom. Tap the small link “skip the tour” at its bottom-right.
steps.see: The card now asks “How do you want to start?” with two choices: “🧪 Keep the examples to play with” and “✨ Start fresh with my own”.
steps.tip: A green greeting may show at the top for a few seconds — it goes away by itself.

steps.do: Tap “✨ Start fresh with my own”. (If a small box asks “Start fresh? The examples will be cleared.”, tap “OK”.)
steps.see: The card closes and you land on the main page: buttons such as “📝 My day”, “🙏 Prayer” and “🌻 Three good things”, and a big “🎙 Talk about today ›”. (On some copies a menu asking “What would you like to do?” comes first. If it does, that is fine: go on to the next step.)

steps.do: If a menu asking “What would you like to do?” is showing, tap “↩ Pick up where I left off”. If you are already on the main page, there is nothing to tap: tap ✅ and go on.
steps.see: The main page is open, with “📅 Today’s page” near the top and the big “🎙 Talk about today ›” button. (On some phones a card “Keep In My Own Words on your Home Screen” also slides up at the bottom; on many Android phones it does not.)
steps.tip: In this version of the app the menu does not come after “Start fresh”, so most testers go straight to the main page and tap ✅ here. The script used to say to tap “Pick up where I left off”, a button that is not there. Emmanuel found it on 11 November.

steps.do: If a “Keep In My Own Words on your Home Screen” card appears, tap “Later”. On many Android phones it does not appear — then just go on.
steps.see: No Home Screen card is covering the page. You can see the big “🎙 Talk about today ›” button.

steps.do: Scroll down to “Whose story is this?”. Tap the “Your name” box and type the name below, then tap anywhere outside the box.
steps.see: The box shows Margaret O'Brien (a small green “Saved ✓” may flash near the bottom).

steps.do: Just below, in “The people in your story”, tap “+ Add” without typing a name.
steps.see: Nothing is added. It still says “No one added yet — start with your spouse or a child.”

steps.do: Tap the “Name” box (just above “+ Add”) and type the name below.
steps.see: “Ann” is in the Name box.

steps.do: Tap the menu beside the name (it says “Spouse”), choose “Daughter”, then tap “+ Add”.
steps.see: A tag “Ann · Daughter ✖” appears, and the “No one added yet” line is gone.

steps.do: Scroll down to “Chapters of your life” and tap “🌱 Beginnings”.
steps.see: The top says “BEGINNINGS — QUESTION 1 OF 4” and asks “Where were you born, and what do you know about the day you arrived?”

steps.do: Do NOT press the red button. Tap the big white box below it (“Your story appears here…”) and type the story below.
steps.type: I was born on a farm near Wichita in a snowstorm. Dad fetched the doctor on the tractor.
steps.see: Your words appear in the box.

steps.do: Below, under “Who is in this story? (tap names)”, tap “Ann”.
steps.see: The “Ann” tag turns solid green.

steps.do: Scroll down and tap “Save & next question ›”.
steps.see: The top now says “BEGINNINGS — QUESTION 2 OF 4” with a new question about the house you grew up in.

steps.do: Scroll to the top and tap “‹ All chapters”.
steps.see: You are back on the main page. Scroll down: “🌱 Beginnings” now says “✓ 1 of 4 told”, and your name Margaret O'Brien is still in the name box.

steps.do: Scroll to the top. In “📅 Today’s page”, tap “🎙 Talk about today ›”.
steps.see: A page opens headed “📅 TODAY’S PAGE” with today’s date and a question, and a “Save today’s page ✓” button lower down.

steps.do: Don’t press the red button. Tap the white box under it and type the sentence below.
steps.type: I hope to bake a pie for the church supper.
steps.see: Your sentence appears in the box.

steps.do: Scroll down and tap “Save today’s page ✓”.
steps.see: You are back on the main page, and the big button now says “✓ Written — add more ›”. A card slides up at the bottom: “One more, if you like”.
steps.tip: In the test copy the purple bar covers that card’s “Not tonight” button — the next step closes the card for you.

steps.do: Pull the page down to reload it (or tap ↻ in Safari).
steps.see: The “One more” card is gone. “✓ Written — add more ›” is still there, and further down Margaret O'Brien, “Ann · Daughter” and “🌱 Beginnings ✓ 1 of 4 told” are all still there.

steps.do: Turn on Airplane Mode (swipe down from the top-right corner, tap ✈️). Then scroll down and tap “📖 See your book so far”.
steps.see: A brown strip at the top says “No connection right now — the app still works and saves on this phone.” The book opens anyway: “Margaret O'Brien's Story”, the 🌱 Beginnings question, your Wichita story, and “In this story: Ann”.

steps.do: Tap “🖨 Print / save as PDF” near the top.
steps.see: A print preview opens. It shows just the book — the title, the Beginnings story and “In this story: Ann” — with no buttons. Tap “Cancel”.

steps.do: Tap “‹ Back to writing” at the top, then turn Airplane Mode off.
steps.see: You are back on the main page: Today’s page says “✓ Written — add more ›” and “🌱 Beginnings” says “✓ 1 of 4 told”.

steps.do: Now the videos. This app has 3. Open each one and watch it right through, sound on: Explain it to me — https://jerrywins1.github.io/daraja-apps/shop/watch.html?app=storykeeper&mode=firsttime  Watch it work — https://jerrywins1.github.io/daraja-apps/shop/watch.html?app=storykeeper  Train me — https://jerrywins1.github.io/daraja-apps/shop/watch.html?app=storykeeper&mode=train
steps.see: Each one talks without stopping — no long silences, no sentence starting again. The screen behind the words changes to match what is being said, and when it points at something, that thing is really there. If a video talks about a button or a screen you did not see in this app, say so — that is a real fault and one of the most useful things you can find.

steps.do: Last, the shop page everyone sees before they buy: https://jerrywins1.github.io/daraja-apps/shop/ — find this app on its shelf and read its card.
steps.see: The name, the one-line description and the price all match the app you just used. Nothing on the card promises something the app does not do. If the card and the app disagree, the card is the fault — say which bit.
